positive_snippets: Had a wonderful stay. Excellent hospitality and a big thanks to Mr Vinit saxena and Mr Manish Chaudhary for the cordial staff and Excellent service at the hotel.
I have stayed for 5 nights, the service is very good Staff is helpful. Food is also good.
When I visited this hotel for the first time, I really liked the staff, their behavior and everything.
negative_snippets: We organised a family function for which we booked around 17 rooms but we only got the access to 13 rooms. Moreover those 13 rooms were very very disappointing and far below our expectations. All kinds of problems like cockroaches to water issues to a lift that was in terrible conditions were to be faced by our guests. Overall it was a terrible experience for us and surely for our guests too.

We booked this place for a simple dinner party. And the management ensured, that the service couldn't be any more worse.
Horrible service. No waiters. No ac.
On complaining, the manager argued that this the best they can do.
For the entire party, we only had 1 server serving 60 + people. 1 server!!!
Booking was minimum 60Pax in writing, and yet the manager made preparations for only 40pax.
On live fruit counter, the server did not even know how to cut/peel fruits. We were served big chunks with peels on!

Even the ac was not working and nobody even bothered to look into the issue despite multiple complaints. Later said, they cannot do anything about the issue at the last hour.

In short, it couldn't have been worse. Lesson for life- DO NOT BOOK THIS PLACE FOR ANY FUNCTION EVER!!
